name: kit.file_version
description: A new version of a brand file: the team's title stays, the file and its date change.
sql: update brandbase.brand_files f set name = btrim(:name), kind = brandbase.file_kind(btrim(:name)), media_id = :mediaId, updated_at = :now::timestamptz where f.id = :id and f.brand_id = :brand returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(f)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(f.updated_at)) as result
